verdict.rationale: ROS 2 ships official client libraries in multiple languages that expose its core functionality. The install docs verify that both the C++ and Python APIs work, and there are official Python APIs for features like bag recording. Community users relevantly note dependency hell and a convoluted build system when building against ROS 2, plus disorganized tutorials. missing for 10: an explicit list of officially supported SDK languages and API-reference depth, AI-native or agent-oriented SDK tooling, independent hands-on corroboration of a smooth SDK developer experience.
